userInputText: Get ready to battle in FNF Minus, where minimalistic visuals meet intense rhythm battles! Can you keep up with the beats and outshine your opponents?FNF Minus invites you to a musical party that never stops dancing. What interesting challenges will the exciting rhythms combined with the dramatic competition atmosphere have? Will your task be simple or difficult to swallow? Let's take a closer look at every nook and cranny of this unmissable music game!Creative and Novel PlotFNF Minus retains the essence of the Friday Night Funkin' game series: you will play the role of Boyfriend, participating in rap battles to win the approval of your lover, Girlfriend. But what makes the difference is that all the characters – from Daddy Dearest, Pico, to Skid and Pump – are designed in new styles. Their image is based on the image icons that appear on the health bar in the game, offering a completely new and curious feeling.Enjoy Signature FeaturesCompletely new character design: Every character in this mod gets a makeover, with an appearance based on their health bar icon.Familiar but Challenging Melodies: The songs remain the same, but with more challenging speed and intensity. This challenge will make you take every key press seriously.Unique Minus graphic style: Characters are not only "remixed", but the entire graphic style also changes, creating a new space.ControlsYou use the arrow keys corresponding to the symbols of the notes to catch the beat.Check out more FNF’s ModsFNF UpSideFNF vs ZardyFNF Week 6
